2608.03095.title: VIVID: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark Exposing the Figurative Language Gap in Vietnamese NLP
2608.03095.paper_summary: We present VIVID (Vietnamese Idioms for Validation and Interpretation Depth), the first systematic benchmark for evaluating culturally grounded figurative language understanding in Vietnamese. VIVID comprises 1,636 idioms and proverbs annotated with five complexity traits (literal expressions, pragmatic nuances, Sino-Vietnamese terms, uncommon vocabulary, folk knowledge) and seven semantic themes. We establish an evaluation framework combining generative and discriminative tasks, proposing an LLM-as-a-Judge approach with aspect-based prompting validated against human judgment (Cohen's kappa = 0.792). Evaluating eight state-of-the-art models reveals critical gaps: Vietnamese-specialized models drastically underperform multilingual systems (VinaLLaMA-7B: 0.13 vs. GPT-4o: 2.46), and even top models achieve less than 50% of maximum scores. Notably, few-shot prompting does not universally improve performance, with GPT-4o exhibiting degradation due to stylistic overfitting. Our analysis exposes systematic failures including literal over-interpretation, lexical gaps, and pragmatic flattening, demonstrating that current models lack cultural competence for nuanced figurative interpretation. VIVID provides an essential tool for advancing figurative language understanding in culturally rich contexts.
2608.03095.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出 VIVID（越南語成語的驗證與解釋深度），這是第一個系統性基準，用於評估越南語中基於文化的隱喻語言理解。VIVID 包含 1,636 個成語和諺語，並標註了五個複雜性特徵（字面表達、語用細微差別、中越詞彙、不常用詞彙、民間知識）以及七個語義主題。我們建立了一個評估框架，結合生成性和區分性任務，提出了 LLM-as-a-Judge 的方法，並通過與人類判斷的驗證（Cohen's kappa = 0.792）進行了基於方面的提示。對八個最先進模型的評估揭示了關鍵差距：專注於越南語的模型在多語言系統中表現大幅不足（VinaLLaMA-7B: 0.13 vs. GPT-4o: 2.46），即使是頂尖模型的得分也未達到最大分數的 50%。值得注意的是，少量提示並不普遍改善性能，GPT-4o 由於風格過擬合而表現下降。我們的分析揭示了系統性失敗，包括字面過度解釋、詞彙缺口和語用平坦化，顯示當前模型缺乏對於細緻隱喻解釋的文化能力。VIVID 提供了一個重要工具，以推進在文化豐富背景下的隱喻語言理解。
